title: Custom kind
description: extensions/kinds/<type>.json: a kind the project declares; its elements live in model/custom/<type>/ and hold the declared fields under content.

type.description: The custom kind's type key; equals the file name without .json (MQ1017).

displayName.description: The custom kind's display name; editors and templates fall back to the type.

pluralName.description: The custom kind's plural; falls back to the inflected display name.

properties.description: A JSON Schema properties object: the keys of an element's content, one schema per key. On a string, or an array's items, x-ref types the value as the id of an element or sub-element (MQ2009). On a top-level string property of the content or of a member item, "x-translatable": true translates its text per locale (MQ7212). On an array whose items are an object schema, "x-member": true makes each item a member with an id the engine owns (MQ1018).

required.description: The keys an element's content must hold; each is a key of properties (MQ1017).
